The operation $a \oplus b = a + b + ab$ satisfies $1 + (a \oplus b) = (1+a)(1+b)$, so the product $P = \prod (1+x)$ over all numbers on the board is invariant.

Initially:
$$P = \prod_{k=1}^{100}\left(1+\frac{1}{k}\right) = \prod_{k=1}^{100}\frac{k+1}{k} = \frac{101}{1} = 101.$$

When one number remains, call it $x$, we have $1 + x = 101$, so $x = 100$.

ANSWER: 100
